title: spec: the update-mode validation preview's named limit should also say it can refuse a row the update accepts
body:
security#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcT1w3zpekijraHJE4f

Follow-up owed by the contract review of PR #33319 (review#2 record 6881097452, finding S2).

## What

`ValidateDataResponseSchema` and the import row report in `packages/spec/src/api` each carry a named limit sentence. It says an `update`-mode preview can report fewer drops than the update itself. After #33319 an update-mode preview can also **refuse** a row that the update accepts: for a value on a field that a read-only strip removes, the preview judges the value, while the update drops it first. That is the safe direction.

## Expected

Widen both limit sentences to name this second divergence. Docs and describe text only; no schema shape changes.

## Where

- `packages/spec/src/api` — `ValidateDataResponseSchema` (the named-limit sentence)
- `packages/spec/src/api` — the import row report (the same sentence)
